amendments.reason: Installer development and package-safety testing are packaging administration, not empirical evidence about the calculus. No research or lane credit is taken for this interval.

other_rules: No O-labelled source recovery, copying, context recovery, or reasoning was retroactively credited as D.
Known serial research-test process durations are separated from engaged E.
O intervals are observed overhead occupancy, not a measurement of engaged human/model computation. Unresolved overhead/tool waiting is not credited to research.
Pre-forecast source setup and post-closing package delivery are unmeasured overhead.
No artificial sleeping, repeated clock polling, or output-size-to-time conversion is used.
